articles.title: Fat Bear Week Returns: The Ultimate Chubby Championship
articles.summary: Fat Bear Week is back! Vote online for the fattest brown bear at Katmai National Park in Alaska. The contest runs from September 22 to 29, 2026, with 16 bears competing.

articles.title: Trailer Heist Foiled: Thieves Get 40,000 Pounds of Sand Instead of Tech
articles.summary: Thieves in California stole two Nvidia-branded trailers, expecting high-tech gear. They got 40,000 pounds of sand instead. The trailers were recovered, and police are investigating.

articles.title: Alcaraz's Smile After 3:34am Defeat: 'I Suffered, But I Enjoyed'
articles.summary: Carlos Alcaraz lost a five-set US Open match at 3:34am but walked off smiling. He said he missed competing after a wrist injury kept him out for months.
